digest.title: Researchers used Claude to hack OpenAI
digest.tldr: Researchers used Claude to reach an OpenAI employee account and sensitive GitHub data.

digest.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping the “largest theft of labor in human history”
digest.tldr: Microsoft, OpenAI emails reveal fear of AI “doom loop” killing news orgs.

digest.title: Microsoft Teams will let admins block custom file extensions
digest.tldr: Microsoft Teams will soon let administrators tweak the list of file extensions commonly associated with security threats to meet their company's security requirements.

digest.title: NASA Awards SpaceX Three Crew Flights to Space Station
digest.tldr: To continue regular crew transportation to the International Space Station, NASA has awarded SpaceX three additional missions through a contract modification.

digest.title: Microsoft fixes bug behind ‘Defender Antivirus is turned off’ alerts
digest.tldr: Microsoft has resolved a known issue that causes incorrect alerts warning that Defender Antivirus was turned off after installing recent updates.
